items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: knew Bab Frank, the, uh, piccolo player? No, I don't know.

ctx.x: No, they had banjo most of the time and guitar.
Uh, did you ever hear, you, uh, knew Bab Frank, the, uh, piccolo player? No, I don't know. Could you, uh, describe anything about a, how, how they band played at a funeral? Do you remember?

Oh yeah, I used to play so many of them. Uh, the, the society that, uh, deceased members belonged to, well they'd meet at one of the halls, like cooperators or the economy, meet the band there and then we'd march around and go to the house where the body was laid out at. We'd stop playing music a couple of blocks from there and we'd wait until, uh, take them out the house and bring them to the church and they'd have the service in the church. We'd have to wait around until sometime, or the last couple of hours…
